review_reasons: Requires new mathematics: A rigorous category-theoretic framework for quantum field theory with boundary conditions, including: (1) A precise definition of the category of boundary conditions Ω with appropriate morphisms, (2) A functorial quantization procedure that respects the categorical structure, (3) A proof that the assignment ω ↦ (γ(ω), |0_ω⟩) preserves categorical morphisms
